nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 state variable holding the Liquidity Asset token used by the FundingLocker.
Immutable address state variable referencing the Loan contract authorized to pull funds.
Constructor of FundingLocker that stores _liquidityAsset into liquidityAsset and _loan into loan.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == loan, the only access-control gate protecting pull and drain.
External isLoan-guarded function transferring amt Liquidity Asset to destination dst.
External isLoan-guarded function transferring the full token balance of this contract to the loan.
Caller-controlled address consumed by the isLoan access-control check.
ERC20 safeTransfer external token transfer executed inside pull, forwarding dst and amt.
ERC20 safeTransfer external token transfer executed inside drain to the loan for the full balance.
Destination address parameter of pull, forwarded to the token transfer.
Amount parameter of pull controlling how many Liquidity Asset tokens are moved.
Constructor parameter assigning the Liquidity Asset token address.
Constructor parameter assigning the authorized Loan address.
Local variable in drain storing liquidityAsset.balanceOf(address(this)) before transfer.
SafeERC20 library function that wraps an optional-return ERC20 transfer call.
SafeERC20 private helper performing the low-level token call and decoding the optional bool return.
Address library function performing a low-level call to a target contract with encoded data.
Low-level target.call{value:value}(data) forwarding all gas to the token contract.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared with the loan state variable inside the isLoan modifier.
The loan state variable is the trusted counterpart used in the require check of isLoan.
The isLoan modifier gates execution of pull.
The isLoan modifier gates execution of drain.
pull invokes the liquidityAsset.safeTransfer operation.
drain invokes the liquidityAsset.safeTransfer operation.
The dst parameter is passed directly as the recipient of safeTransfer in pull.
The amt parameter is passed directly as the amount of safeTransfer in pull.
The liquidityAsset state variable is the token on which safeTransfer is called in pull.
The liquidityAsset state variable is the token on which safeTransfer is called in drain.
drain stores liquidityAsset.balanceOf(address(this)) in the local amt variable.
The local amt variable is passed as the amount of safeTransfer in drain.
The loan state variable is passed as the recipient of safeTransfer in drain.
pull calls into the external token contract via the SafeERC20.safeTransfer library function.
drain calls into the external token contract via the SafeERC20.safeTransfer library function.
safeTransfer delegates the actual token call to _callOptionalReturn.
_callOptionalReturn uses Address.functionCall to invoke the token.
functionCall performs a low-level call that yields control to the untrusted token contract.
The constructor assigns _liquidityAsset to the liquidityAsset state variable.
The constructor assigns _loan to the loan state variable.
The _liquidityAsset constructor parameter initializes the liquidityAsset state variable.
The _loan constructor parameter initializes the loan state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The dst parameter has no standalone semantics; it only feeds the safeTransfer token transfer in pull and should be folded into that unsafe_operation node.
The amt parameter of pull exists solely to size the safeTransfer call and should be merged into the safeTransfer_pull unsafe_operation node.
The _liquidityAsset parameter is consumed immediately by the constructor to set the liquidityAsset state variable and has no independent behavior.
The _loan parameter is consumed immediately by the constructor to set the loan state variable and has no independent behavior.
The local amt variable in drain is derived from balanceOf and used only as the amount for the safeTransfer in drain, so it should be merged into that unsafe_operation node.
